name: Mutton Dum Biryani Full Plate
instructions: Marinate mutton with curd, ginger, garlic, red chilli powder, garam masala, turmeric and salt for 30 minutes.
Soak basmati rice for 20 minutes, parboil with whole spices (bay leaf, cloves, cinnamon, black cardamom) until 70% done, drain.
In a heavy pot heat ghee and mustard oil together, fry sliced onions until golden brown.
Add marinated mutton and cook on high heat for 10 minutes, then reduce and cook 20 minutes until nearly tender.
Layer parboiled rice over mutton, top with fried onions, saffron milk, fresh coriander.
Seal pot with dough or foil, cook on dum on low heat for 25 minutes.
Rest 10 minutes before opening. Mix gently and serve with raita.

name: Punjabi Chicken Curry Dal Rice Thali
instructions: Marinate chicken thigh pieces with curd, turmeric, red chilli powder, salt for 15 minutes.
Heat mustard oil in a kadai, add onions and cook until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste and tomatoes, cook into a thick masala.
Add marinated chicken, cook on medium heat 25 minutes until done. Finish with garam masala and coriander.
Separately pressure cook toor dal with tomato, turmeric, salt. Temper with ghee, cumin, garlic, red chilli.
Cook basmati rice separately. Serve rice topped with dal and chicken curry alongside two phulka rotis.
Garnish with fresh coriander and a wedge of lemon.

name: Andhra Spicy Chicken Rice Bowl
instructions: Grind onion, tomato, ginger, garlic, dried red chillies, coriander seeds and poppy seeds into a coarse paste.
Heat groundnut oil in a thick-bottomed pot, add mustard seeds, curry leaves, then the ground masala paste.
Cook masala on medium heat 10 minutes until oil separates. Add chicken thigh pieces, turmeric and salt.
Add half a cup of water, cover and cook 25 minutes on medium heat until chicken is tender and gravy is thick.
Finish with garam masala and fresh coriander.
Serve over a generous portion of cooked sona masoori rice.

name: Bengali Rohu Fish Curry with Rice and Dal
instructions: Marinate rohu pieces with turmeric and salt. Pan-fry in mustard oil until golden on both sides, set aside.
In the same pan fry nigella seeds (substitute: mustard seeds), green chilli, onion, ginger-garlic paste until golden.
Add tomato, potato cubes, turmeric, red chilli powder and cook 5 minutes. Add 1 cup water and bring to boil.
Slide in fried fish pieces, simmer 10 minutes until potato is cooked and gravy is light.
Cook masoor dal separately with turmeric; temper with mustard seeds, garlic, dried red chilli in mustard oil.
Serve fish curry and dal over sona masoori rice.

name: Mutton Keema Paratha Thali with Egg
instructions: Make a soft dough with whole wheat flour, salt and water. Rest 20 minutes.
Dry-cook mutton keema (minced) in a kadai with onion, ginger-garlic, tomato, red chilli, garam masala until moisture evaporates.
Divide dough into 3 balls. Stuff each with keema filling, roll gently into thick parathas.
Cook each paratha on tawa with ghee until golden brown on both sides.
Scramble two eggs with onion, green chilli and salt in the same pan.
Serve parathas with scrambled egg, a side of curd and fresh coriander.

name: Kerala Prawn Coconut Curry with Red Rice
instructions: Heat coconut oil in a clay pot or kadai. Add mustard seeds, curry leaves and dried red chillies.
Add onions, ginger, garlic and green chillies; sauté until onions soften.
Add tomatoes, turmeric, red chilli powder and coriander powder; cook until oil separates.
Add cashew paste (blended cashews with water as coconut milk substitute) and 150ml water; bring to simmer.
Add cleaned prawns and cook 8-10 minutes until cooked through. Adjust salt.
Serve over cooked parboiled rice with coriander garnish.

name: Punjabi Paneer Rajma Rice Thali
instructions: Pressure cook soaked rajma until soft. Reserve cooking liquid.
Fry onion, ginger-garlic paste in mustard oil; add tomato, red chilli powder, garam masala, cook into thick masala.
Add cooked rajma and its liquid, simmer 10 minutes. Finish with fresh cream and coriander.
Pan-fry paneer cubes in ghee until golden. Add to a quick tomato-onion gravy with spices.
Cook basmati rice separately. Serve rice with rajma and paneer curry.
Accompany with a small katori of curd.

name: Paneer Chana Dal Roti Thali
instructions: Pressure cook chana dal until soft. Temper with ghee, cumin, onion, ginger, tomato, turmeric and salt.
Prepare paneer bhurji: crumble paneer; sauté onion, capsicum, tomato in oil; add paneer, spices, cook 5 minutes.
Make 3 whole wheat rotis on a hot tawa with a smear of ghee.
Cook basmati rice with cumin. Serve dal, paneer bhurji, cumin rice and rotis together.
Add small katori curd with a pinch of cumin powder to complete the thali.

name: Malai Kofta with Jeera Rice
instructions: Grate paneer and mash potato. Mix together with salt, green chilli and cumin. Shape into 5-6 small balls.
Shallow-fry koftas in ghee until golden. Set aside.
Blend cashews with warm water to a paste. Cook onion-tomato-ginger-garlic masala in ghee.
Add cashew paste, red chilli powder, garam masala, fresh cream. Simmer 10 minutes into a rich gravy.
Gently add koftas to gravy just before serving.
Cook basmati rice with cumin seeds and ghee. Plate kofta curry over jeera rice.

name: Full Portion Bisi Bele Bath with Extra Ghee
instructions: Pressure cook sona masoori rice and toor dal (2:1 ratio) together with turmeric and salt until very soft.
Add tamarind pulp, jaggery, red chilli powder, coriander seeds powder and vegetables (carrot, potato, green peas). Mix well and cook 10 minutes.
Heat ghee in a small pan, add mustard seeds, dried red chillies, curry leaves, cashews and peanuts. When golden, pour tadka into the bath.
Mix everything into a thick porridge consistency. Adjust salt.
Serve hot topped with extra ghee and a papad alongside.

name: Chicken Breast Curry Roti Thali
instructions: Cut chicken breast into chunks. Marinate with curd, ginger-garlic paste, red chilli powder, turmeric and salt.
Heat oil in a kadai, fry onions until golden. Add tomato, spices and cook until masala leaves oil.
Add marinated chicken with all marinade. Cook covered on medium heat 20 minutes.
Finish with garam masala, kasuri methi and coriander.
Make 3 whole wheat rotis on tawa with ghee. Serve chicken curry with rotis and a side of dal.

name: Rajasthani Mutton Curry Rice Bowl
instructions: Soak dried red chillies (Mathania or Kashmiri) in warm water 15 minutes. Blend into smooth paste.
Heat mustard oil in a heavy pot to smoking point, cool slightly. Fry onions until deep brown.
Add ginger-garlic paste, red chilli paste, turmeric and mutton. Sear on high heat 10 minutes.
Add water, cover and pressure cook 25-30 minutes until mutton is fall-off-bone tender.
Open cooker, cook down gravy to thick consistency. Finish with garam masala and coriander.
Cook basmati rice with cumin separately. Serve mutton curry generously over rice.

name: Chettinad Mutton Kuzhambu
instructions: Grind a paste: poppy seeds, coconut (substitute cashews), fennel seeds, cinnamon, cloves, green cardamom.
Heat groundnut oil, add star anise, fennel seeds, curry leaves, onion and sauté until brown.
Add ginger-garlic paste, tomato, red chilli powder, coriander seeds powder and cook 8 minutes.
Add mutton pieces, sear 5 minutes. Add ground paste, tamarind pulp and 1 cup water.
Pressure cook 25 minutes until mutton is tender. Simmer open for 10 minutes to thicken.
Serve with cooked sona masoori rice.

name: Goan Pomfret Curry with Rice
instructions: Grind cashews with dried red chillies, coriander seeds, cumin, garlic and tamarind into a thick paste.
Heat coconut oil, sauté onions until translucent. Add the ground paste and cook 5 minutes.
Add water to desired consistency, bring to a boil. Add pomfret pieces and turmeric.
Simmer 12-15 minutes until fish is cooked and curry thickens. Adjust salt and sourness.
Cook parboiled rice separately. Serve curry over rice.

name: Egg Masala Curry Roti Dal Dinner
instructions: Hard boil 3 eggs and peel them. Score with a knife and shallow fry in oil until lightly golden. Set aside.
In the same pan sauté onion until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste, tomato, red chilli powder, garam masala and coriander powder.
Cook masala until oil separates. Add eggs, coat with masala, simmer with a splash of water 5 minutes.
Pressure cook masoor dal with turmeric, salt and tomato. Temper with ghee and cumin.
Make 3 whole wheat rotis on a tawa with ghee. Serve egg curry, dal and rotis together.

name: Palak Paneer with Stuffed Paratha Thali
instructions: Blanch spinach, blend to smooth puree. Make a basic onion-tomato-ginger-garlic masala in ghee.
Add spinach puree, cream, garam masala and paneer cubes. Simmer 8 minutes. Adjust salt.
Mix grated paneer with spices for paratha filling. Stuff into whole wheat dough balls, roll and cook on tawa with ghee.
Serve palak paneer with 2 paneer parathas and a small bowl of curd.

name: Paneer Makhani with Butter Naan
instructions: Blend tomatoes and cashews into smooth puree. Cook in butter with ginger-garlic paste until thick.
Add red chilli powder, garam masala, sugar, kasuri methi and fresh cream. Simmer 8 minutes.
Add paneer cubes, mix gently and cook 5 minutes. Adjust salt.
Make naan dough with maida, curd, baking powder and butter. Rest 20 minutes, roll out.
Cook naan on a hot tawa or under grill, brush with butter.
Serve rich paneer makhani with 2 butter naans.

name: Creamy Dal Makhani with Whole Wheat Roti
instructions: Pressure cook whole urad dal and rajma together until very soft. Mash lightly.
In a thick-bottomed pot heat butter and oil. Sauté onions until golden, add ginger-garlic paste, tomatoes.
Cook masala until thick and oil separates. Add cooked dal with cooking liquid.
Simmer 30 minutes on low heat, stirring frequently. Add cream, garam masala and kasuri methi.
Make 4 whole wheat rotis with ghee. Serve dal makhani with rotis and a pat of butter on top.

name: Vegan Rajma Sweet Potato Masala Rice
name_alt: Red Kidney Bean Sweet Potato Bowl
instructions: Pressure cook soaked rajma until soft. Reserve liquid.
Dice and boil sweet potato until just tender.
Heat mustard oil, add cumin, onion, ginger, garlic, tomato and cook into thick masala.
Add rajma with liquid and sweet potato. Simmer 10 minutes. Season with red chilli, garam masala, salt.
Cook basmati rice with cumin seeds separately.
Serve rajma sweet potato masala over rice topped with coriander and lemon juice.

name: Vegan Chana Masala with Peanut Rice
instructions: Pressure cook kabuli chana until soft. Heat groundnut oil in kadai, add mustard seeds, cumin, curry leaves.
Sauté onion, ginger, garlic until golden. Add tomato, red chilli powder, garam masala and coriander powder.
Add cooked chana with some liquid. Simmer 10 minutes to thicken. Adjust salt and add tamarind.
Cook sona masoori rice. In a separate pan dry-roast peanuts, mix into rice with mustard oil, salt and lemon.
Serve chana masala over peanut rice with fresh coriander.

name: Vegan Lobia Potato Masala Rice Bowl
instructions: Pressure cook soaked lobia until tender.
Heat mustard oil, temper with cumin and bay leaf. Add onion, ginger, garlic and cook golden.
Add tomato, spices, potato cubes. Cook 8 minutes. Add lobia with liquid and simmer 15 minutes.
Finish with amchur powder, garam masala and coriander.
Cook basmati rice. Serve lobia potato masala over rice.

name: Vegan Kala Chana Masoor Dal Khichdi
name_alt: Black Chickpea Red Lentil One Pot
instructions: Soak kala chana overnight. Cook with masoor dal and basmati rice together in pressure cooker with turmeric, salt and water (ratio 1:3) until very soft.
Heat mustard oil in a tadka pan. Add cumin, asafoetida, onion, ginger, tomato and cook into a quick masala.
Add red chilli powder, garam masala. Pour tadka over khichdi and mix.
Top with peanuts and coriander. Serve hot with a drizzle of mustard oil.

name: Vegan Horse Gram Sambar Rice Bowl
instructions: Pressure cook horse gram until soft (takes longer than regular dal). Mash partially.
Cook drumstick, brinjal and tomato in tamarind water with sambar powder (red chilli + coriander + cumin).
Add cooked horse gram. Simmer 10 minutes until thick sambar consistency.
Temper with coconut oil, mustard seeds, curry leaves, dried red chilli and asafoetida.
Serve over generous serving of cooked sona masoori rice with a drizzle of sesame oil.

name: Vegan Moong Chana Vegetable Pulao
instructions: Rinse moong dal and kabuli chana. Soak chana 4 hours. Pressure cook chana separately until 80% done.
Heat mustard oil in pressure cooker, add whole spices (bay leaf, cumin, cloves, cinnamon).
Add onion, ginger, garlic, green peas, carrot and cook 3 minutes. Add moong dal (no soaking needed), chana and rinsed basmati rice.
Add spices, 1.5 cups water and pressure cook 2 whistles.
Fluff with fork, garnish with coriander and serve with lemon wedge.

name: Vegan Rajma Oat Kofte Tomato Gravy Bowl
instructions: Cook and mash rajma. Mix with rolled oats, onion, garlic, ginger, cumin, red chilli powder and salt. Form into small balls.
Shallow fry kofte in groundnut oil until golden on all sides. Set aside.
Make tomato gravy: blend tomatoes; cook in oil with onion, ginger-garlic paste, red chilli, garam masala until thick.
Add kofte to gravy, simmer gently 5 minutes.
Serve with cooked basmati rice and garnish of coriander.

name: Vegan Toor Dal Sesame Rice Bowl
instructions: Pressure cook toor dal until soft with turmeric. Prepare a tomato-tamarind sambar base.
Temper in coconut oil: mustard seeds, curry leaves, dried red chilli, asafoetida. Add to dal.
Dry-roast sesame seeds and mix with cooked sona masoori rice, sesame oil, lemon juice and salt to make sesame rice.
Serve dal over sesame rice. Garnish with coriander.
Optionally add roasted peanuts for extra protein and crunch.

name: Vegan Matki Aloo Curry Rice
instructions: Sprout or soak matki overnight. Pressure cook with salt and turmeric until tender.
Heat groundnut oil, add mustard seeds, curry leaves, onion, ginger and cook until golden.
Add potato cubes, tomato, red chilli powder, garam masala and cook 8 minutes.
Add cooked matki with liquid, simmer 10 minutes until thick.
Serve over cooked sona masoori rice with lemon and coriander.

name: Vegan Whole Moong Spinach Dal Rice
instructions: Soak whole moong overnight. Pressure cook until soft.
Heat mustard oil, add cumin, onion, ginger, garlic and cook golden.
Add tomato, spinach, turmeric, red chilli powder. Cook until spinach wilts.
Add cooked moong, simmer 10 minutes. Finish with garam masala, lemon juice and coriander.
Serve over plain basmati rice.

name: Vegan Urad Dal Khichdi with Cashew Tadka
instructions: Rinse urad dal and basmati rice. Pressure cook together (1:1.5) with turmeric and salt until soft.
Heat groundnut oil in a tadka pan. Add cashews and fry golden. Add cumin, asafoetida, dried red chilli, garlic and ginger.
Pour sizzling tadka over khichdi.
Stir gently, adjust salt. Serve hot with a side of pickle (achaar).

name: Vegan Bengali Cholar Dal Aloo Rice
instructions: Pressure cook chana dal until soft but not mushy.
Heat coconut oil or mustard oil, add bay leaf, dried red chilli, cumin. Add onion, potato cubes.
Cook potato until golden. Add tomato, turmeric, salt and chana dal.
Simmer 10 minutes. Add cashews (Bengali style), coconut oil finish and a little jaggery.
Serve over cooked sona masoori rice.

name: Vegan Peanut Rice with Drumstick Sambar
instructions: Dry roast peanuts until skins crack. Remove skins. Coarsely grind with dried red chillies, cumin, garlic.
Cook sona masoori rice. Mix peanut powder into rice with sesame oil, lemon juice and salt.
Prepare quick sambar: pressure cook toor dal with drumstick, tomato, tamarind, turmeric.
Temper sambar with mustard seeds, curry leaves in coconut oil. Add asafoetida.
Serve peanut rice with generous ladle of drumstick sambar.

name: Vegan Lobia Tamarind Rice Bowl
instructions: Soak lobia 4 hours and pressure cook until tender.
Prepare tamarind rice: cook sona masoori rice. In sesame oil, fry mustard seeds, peanuts, dried red chillies, curry leaves, asafoetida.
Add tamarind concentrate, turmeric, jaggery and salt. Cook into a thick paste. Mix into rice.
Cook lobia in a separate pan with tomato, onion, garlic, ginger and spices.
Serve lobia alongside tamarind rice.

name: Vegan Oats Poha Peanut Upma
instructions: Mix rolled oats and poha together, rinse briefly and squeeze out moisture.
Heat groundnut oil in a pan. Add mustard seeds, curry leaves, peanuts and fry until peanuts are golden.
Add onion, green chilli, ginger and cook 2 minutes. Add potato cubes and cook 5 minutes.
Add oats-poha mixture, turmeric, salt and lemon juice. Mix and cook on medium heat 5 minutes.
Garnish with fresh coriander and serve hot.

name: Vegan Rajma Broken Wheat Savory Porridge
instructions: Pressure cook broken wheat (dalia) and cooked rajma together with water, turmeric and salt for 3 whistles.
Heat mustard oil, add cumin, onion, ginger and tomato. Cook into quick masala.
Pour tadka over porridge, mix well. Add lemon juice and coriander.
Serve hot as a filling breakfast.

name: Vegan Chana Sweet Potato Hash
instructions: Boil or microwave sweet potato until just tender. Dice small.
Heat mustard oil in a non-stick pan on high heat. Add mustard seeds, curry leaves.
Add onion and cook 3 minutes. Add diced sweet potato and cook until edges brown.
Add cooked kabuli chana, red chilli powder, garam masala, amchur and salt. Toss well.
Cook 5 minutes until chana is slightly crispy. Serve with lemon and coriander.

name: Vegan Semolina Moong Dal Savory Cake
instructions: Soak moong dal 2 hours and blend coarsely with ginger, green chilli and water.
Mix in semolina, salt, turmeric and lemon juice. Rest 10 minutes (batter self-rises slightly).
Pour batter into a greased steaming dish. Steam 15 minutes until set.
Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves, sesame seeds in groundnut oil and pour over steamed cake.
Cool slightly, cut into pieces and serve hot with green chutney.

name: Vegan Pearl Millet Peanut Savory Porridge
instructions: Dry roast pearl millet flour lightly in a pan until fragrant. Set aside.
Heat mustard oil, add mustard seeds, cumin, dried red chilli and asafoetida.
Add onion, ginger, green chilli and cook 2 minutes. Add water (1.5 cups) and bring to boil.
Whisk in pearl millet flour gradually to avoid lumps. Cook 8-10 minutes stirring continuously.
Add roasted peanuts, salt and lemon juice. Mix well.
Serve hot topped with coriander. Can add a drizzle of groundnut oil.

name: Egg Potato Paratha Breakfast Thali
instructions: Make dough with whole wheat flour, salt and water. Rest 15 minutes.
Mash boiled potato with spices, chopped onion, green chilli and coriander for filling.
Roll dough into thick paratha, stuff with potato filling, roll gently and cook on tawa with ghee.
Meanwhile scramble 2 eggs with onion, green chilli, tomato and salt in butter.
Serve 2 aloo parathas with scrambled eggs, a dollop of butter and a small katori of curd.

name: Paneer Cashew Vegetable Pulao
instructions: Soak basmati rice 20 minutes. Heat ghee in a pressure cooker.
Fry cashews until golden, set aside. In same ghee fry onion slices until brown.
Add whole spices (cardamom, cloves, cinnamon, bay leaf), ginger-garlic paste. Add green peas, carrot.
Add rice and 1.5 cups water. Pressure cook 2 whistles.
Meanwhile pan-fry paneer cubes in ghee until golden. Add to rice with fried cashews.
Garnish with coriander and serve with raita.

name: Chicken Keema Egg Rice Bowl
instructions: Heat oil in a pan, add cumin, onion, ginger-garlic paste and cook until golden.
Add minced chicken, break apart and cook until colour changes.
Add tomato, red chilli powder, garam masala, turmeric and salt. Cook 15 minutes until moisture dries.
Add green peas, cook 5 more minutes. Finish with kasuri methi and coriander.
Fry 2 eggs sunny side up or over easy. Serve keema over basmati rice topped with fried eggs.

name: Sindhi Besan Kadhi with Rice and Pakora
instructions: Roast besan in ghee until fragrant and colour changes slightly. Whisk in curd and water to a smooth paste.
Add tamarind, turmeric, red chilli powder, salt. Bring to boil and simmer 20 minutes, stirring.
Add drumstick, potato and cluster beans. Cook until vegetables are tender.
Make besan pakoras with onion, green chilli and spices. Deep fry or air fry until golden.
Cook basmati rice separately. Serve Sindhi kadhi with rice and pakoras.

name: Catla Fish Jhol with Rice and Dal
instructions: Marinate catla steaks with turmeric and salt. Shallow fry in mustard oil until golden.
In remaining oil add cumin, bay leaf, onion, ginger-garlic paste and cook.
Add tomato, potato, cauliflower florets, turmeric, red chilli powder and water.
Bring to boil, add fried fish and simmer 12 minutes.
Cook moong dal with turmeric and salt. Temper with mustard oil, cumin, dried red chilli.
Serve fish jhol and dal over sona masoori rice.

name: Vegan Kala Chana Tamarind Gravy Bowl
instructions: Soak kala chana overnight. Pressure cook until tender.
Heat mustard oil, add cumin, onion, ginger, garlic and cook golden.
Add tomato, tamarind pulp, red chilli powder, coriander powder, turmeric and garam masala.
Add cooked kala chana with its liquid. Simmer 15 minutes until gravy is rich.
Add potato (boiled, cubed). Mix gently. Finish with amchur and coriander.
Serve over sona masoori rice.

name: Vegan Rajma Walnut Stir Bowl
instructions: Pressure cook soaked rajma until soft. Roughly mash a quarter for creamy texture.
Heat mustard oil, add cumin, bay leaf, onion, ginger, garlic and cook golden.
Add tomato, spices and cooked rajma. Simmer 10 minutes until thick.
Toast walnuts lightly, roughly chop and stir into the rajma at the end.
Serve over basmati rice with lemon and coriander.

name: Egg Paneer Double Curry Rice Thali
instructions: Hard boil 2 eggs. Fry in oil until golden on outside.
Make a shared onion-tomato-ginger-garlic-spice masala. Divide into two pans.
In one pan add paneer cubes and cream — cook 5 minutes for paneer gravy.
In other pan add eggs, simmer 5 minutes for egg curry.
Cook basmati rice with cumin. Serve rice with both curries alongside.
Garnish each with coriander.

name: Vegan Green Moong Pumpkin Khichdi
instructions: Soak whole moong 2 hours. Rinse sona masoori rice.
Heat mustard oil in pressure cooker. Add mustard seeds, cumin, curry leaves, ginger.
Add pumpkin cubes, rice and moong dal. Add 2 cups water, turmeric, salt and jaggery.
Pressure cook 3 whistles until very soft.
Drizzle with coconut oil, add lemon juice and serve hot.

name: Maharashtrian Chicken Thigh Masala Rice
instructions: Dry roast: coriander seeds, cumin, dried red chillies, poppy seeds, sesame seeds. Grind to paste with ginger, garlic and onion.
Heat groundnut oil in a kadai, add peanuts and roast. Add the spice paste and cook until oil separates.
Add chicken thigh pieces, sear. Add tomato and water. Cover and cook 25 minutes.
Add tamarind, garam masala and salt. Simmer 5 more minutes.
Serve over cooked sona masoori rice.

name: Paneer Almond Gravy with Roti
instructions: Soak almonds in warm water 20 minutes, peel and blend with curd to smooth paste.
Cook onion-ginger-garlic masala in ghee. Add tomato, spices, cook until thick.
Add almond-curd paste and simmer 8 minutes on low heat.
Add paneer cubes, butter and kasuri methi. Cook 5 minutes. Adjust salt.
Make 3 whole wheat rotis on tawa with ghee.
Serve creamy paneer almond curry with rotis.

name: Prawn Egg Indo-Chinese Fried Rice
instructions: Cook basmati rice al dente, spread to cool and dry (preferably day-old).
Heat sesame oil in a wok on very high heat. Scramble 2 eggs briefly, keep slightly runny. Push to side.
Add cleaned prawns, cook 2-3 minutes until pink.
Add onion, capsicum, carrot, garlic and stir fry 2 minutes on high heat.
Add rice, soy sauce (substitute: salt + a little black pepper), white pepper, spring onion.
Toss vigorously on high heat 3-4 minutes. Serve immediately.

name: Vegan Whole Urad Dal Palak Roti Combo
instructions: Soak whole urad overnight. Pressure cook until soft.
In mustard oil cook onion, ginger, garlic, tomato into masala. Add blanched and blended spinach.
Add cooked urad dal, spices, simmer 15 minutes on low. Add lemon juice.
Make 4 whole wheat rotis on tawa with mustard oil. (No ghee to keep vegan.)
Serve dal palak with rotis and extra lemon.

name: Egg Whole Wheat Noodle Masala Bowl
instructions: Boil whole wheat vermicelli al dente, drain and toss with a few drops of oil.
Heat sesame oil in a wok. Scramble 2 eggs, push to side.
Add onion, capsicum, carrot, garlic and stir-fry 2 minutes on high.
Add noodles, red chilli powder, black pepper, salt and lemon juice. Toss 2 minutes.
Serve hot topped with coriander.

name: Masoor Dal Spinach Paratha Dinner
instructions: Cook masoor dal with turmeric and salt until soft. Prepare a tadka with ghee, cumin, garlic, dried red chilli and pour over dal.
Blanch and drain spinach. Knead into whole wheat dough with spices for green paratha dough.
Roll out 3 parathas from spinach dough and cook on tawa with ghee.
Serve masoor dal with spinach parathas and a katori of curd.
Garnish dal with coriander and lemon.

name: Vegan Moong Sprout Poha Peanut Bowl
instructions: Rinse and squeeze excess water from poha. Mix with moong sprouts.
Heat groundnut oil. Add mustard seeds, curry leaves, peanuts — fry until peanuts are golden.
Add onion, green chilli and ginger. Cook 2 minutes.
Add poha-sprout mixture, turmeric, salt and lemon juice. Toss and cook on medium heat 5 minutes.
Add pomegranate seeds for garnish (optional). Serve with coriander.

name: Vegan Kabuli Chana Cashew Pulao
instructions: Soak kabuli chana overnight. Pressure cook with salt and turmeric until soft but not mushy.
Heat sunflower oil in a heavy pot. Add cumin seeds, let them splutter.
Add onion and sauté until golden brown. Add ginger-garlic paste and cook 2 minutes.
Add tomatoes, red chilli powder, garam masala and cook until oil separates.
Add soaked and drained basmati rice, cooked chana, green peas and 2 cups water. Season with salt.
Cover and cook on low heat 18 minutes until rice is fluffy and water is absorbed.
Dry roast cashews until golden. Fold into the pulao with fresh coriander before serving.

name: Vegan Urad Rajma Dal Rice
instructions: Soak whole urad dal and rajma separately overnight. Drain.
Pressure cook urad and rajma together with turmeric and salt until very soft and creamy, about 30 minutes.
In a pan heat mustard oil, add cumin seeds, ginger-garlic paste and onions. Sauté until golden.
Add chopped tomatoes, red chilli powder, garam masala. Cook until masala thickens and oil separates.
Add the cooked dal-rajma mixture to the masala. Simmer 15 minutes, mashing slightly for creaminess.
Add cashew paste (blended cashews with water) for richness. Simmer 5 more minutes.
Cook basmati rice separately. Serve dal generously over rice, garnished with coriander.

name: Vegan Lobia Peanut Rice Bowl
instructions: Soak lobia overnight. Pressure cook with turmeric and salt until tender.
Cook sona masoori rice separately until fluffy.
Heat coconut oil in a kadai. Add mustard seeds, let them pop. Add curry leaves and dried red chillies.
Add diced onion, ginger, garlic and sauté until lightly browned.
Add diced carrot and tomato. Cook 5 minutes until soft.
Add cooked lobia with some cooking liquid, red chilli powder and simmer 10 minutes.
Dry roast peanuts until crunchy. Serve lobia curry over rice topped with roasted peanuts and coriander.

name: Vegan Palak Moong Khichdi Light
instructions: Wash moong dal and basmati rice together. Soak 15 minutes, drain.
Heat mustard oil in a pressure cooker. Add cumin seeds and let them splutter.
Add chopped onion and sauté until translucent. Add ginger, garlic and green chilli.
Add chopped tomato and turmeric. Cook 3 minutes.
Add washed spinach and stir until wilted.
Add rice-dal mixture, salt and 2.5 cups water. Pressure cook for 3 whistles.
Let pressure release naturally. Open and mash lightly. Serve hot with lemon wedge.

name: Vegan Masoor Tomato Rice Light
instructions: Wash masoor dal and pressure cook with turmeric and salt until soft. Mash lightly.
Cook sona masoori rice separately until fluffy.
Heat sunflower oil in a pan. Add mustard seeds and let them pop.
Add curry leaves, dried red chilli and cumin. Sauté 30 seconds.
Add onion and cook until soft. Add ginger, garlic and diced carrot.
Add tomatoes and cook until broken down into a thick sauce.
Pour the tempering into the dal. Mix well. Squeeze lemon juice over.
Serve dal over rice with fresh coriander.

name: Vegan Toor Dal Gobi Rice Light
instructions: Pressure cook toor dal with turmeric and salt until very soft. Mash well.
Cook basmati rice separately until fluffy.
Cut cauliflower into small florets. Blanch or steam until just tender.
Heat mustard oil in a pan. Add mustard seeds, dried red chilli and curry leaves.
Add onion, ginger and garlic. Sauté until onion is translucent.
Add tomato and cook until soft. Add cauliflower florets and cumin. Toss 2 minutes.
Pour cooked dal over the cauliflower tempering. Simmer together 5 minutes.
Serve dal-gobi over rice garnished with coriander.

name: Vegan Palak Masoor Dal Bajra Roti
instructions: Pressure cook masoor dal with turmeric and salt until very soft.
Add washed and chopped spinach to the dal. Cook open 5 minutes until spinach wilts and blends in.
Heat sunflower oil in a small pan. Add cumin seeds, ginger, garlic and green chilli. Sauté 1 minute.
Add chopped onion and cook until golden. Add chopped tomato and cook until soft.
Pour the tempering into the palak dal. Mix and simmer 5 minutes.
Knead pearl millet flour with warm water and salt into a soft dough. Divide into 2 balls.
Pat or roll each ball into a thick roti. Cook on a hot tawa until brown spots appear on both sides.
Serve bajra rotis with palak masoor dal, garnished with coriander.
